title: Vigil rite recipe
description: One rite as the user experiences it: an engine plus its knobs and copy. Packs in data/rites/*.json are {"pack": name, "recipes": [recipe, ...]}. Params are checked against data/schema/<engine>.params.schema.json. Registry.validate() enforces the parts the app relies on.

engine.description: Engine id, a key of Registry.ENGINES.

chain.description: Reserved: compound rites (two engines in sequence).

style.description: The rite's own look; no two recipes may share ground + stroke + font + ink.

lines.description: Copy overrides by key; a string, an array (one is picked), or null to use the engine's pool.
